# typed-totp

> TypeScript-first, zero-runtime-dependency TOTP (RFC 6238) and HOTP (RFC 4226) library built around composable, dependency-injected abstractions — Clock, RandomSource, HmacProvider, SecretCodec, TokenComparator — with secure Web Crypto-backed defaults.

typed-totp generates and verifies time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords. It exposes a simple functional API for typical use and an object-oriented, dependency-injectable API for testing and customization. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM-only, targets Node.js >= 20 and any browser with Web Crypto. It is a cryptographic primitive, not a full MFA system: secret storage, replay protection, and rate limiting are the integrating application's responsibility (see SECURITY.md).

Install: `npm install typed-totp`

## Core docs

- [README](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/blob/main/README.md): architecture, abstraction boundaries, both API levels, dependency-injection example, RFC compliance details, platform support.
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/blob/main/SECURITY.md): what the library does and deliberately does not do, secret handling, clock drift, randomness, rate limiting guidance.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.

## Functional API (typical use)

- `generateSecret(options?: { byteLength?: number }): string` — random Base32 secret.
- `generateTotp(secret: string, options?): Promise<string>` — current TOTP code.
- `verifyTotp(token: string, secret: string, options?): Promise<boolean>`
- `verifyTotpDetailed(token: string, secret: string, options?): Promise<TotpVerificationResult>` — reports which time step matched.
- `toOtpAuthUri(options: { issuer, account, secret, algorithm?, digits?, period? }): string` — `otpauth://` provisioning URI for QR codes.

Source: [src/api/](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/tree/main/src/api)

## Object-oriented / dependency-injectable API

- `class Totp` — construct with `{ secret, algorithm?, digits?, period? }` plus optional `{ clock, hmac, codec, comparator }` dependency overrides. Methods: `generate()`, `verify()`, `verifyDetailed()`, `with(overrides)`.
- `class Hotp` — the RFC 4226 primitive `Totp` delegates to (counter -> HMAC -> dynamic truncation -> decimal formatting).
- `class TotpSecret` — immutable secret value object: `fromBase32()`, `fromBytes()`, `generate()`, `toBase32()`, `toBytes()`.
- `class TotpConfiguration` — immutable, validated `{ algorithm, digits, period }`: `create()`, `with()`.
- `class OtpAuthUriBuilder` — `build()` the `otpauth://` URI (what `toOtpAuthUri` wraps).

Source: [src/domain/](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/tree/main/src/domain), [src/provisioning/](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/tree/main/src/provisioning)

## Extension points (ports)

Implement one of these to swap a collaborator; each ships a secure default and a JSDoc `@example` showing a custom implementation:

- `Clock` (default: `SystemClock`; `FixedClock` for tests)
- `RandomSource` (default: `WebCryptoRandomSource`)
- `HmacProvider` (default: `WebCryptoHmacProvider`)
- `SecretCodec` (default: `Base32Codec`)
- `TokenComparator` (default: `ConstantTimeComparator`)

Source: [src/ports/](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/tree/main/src/ports), [src/adapters/](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/tree/main/src/adapters)

## Errors

`TotpError` (base) with subclasses `InvalidSecretError`, `InvalidConfigurationError`, `UnsupportedAlgorithmError`. `verify`/`verifyTotp` never throw on a wrong or malformed token — they return `false`.

Source: [src/errors/index.ts](https://github.com/Kayange123/typed-totp/blob/main/src/errors/index.ts)
